mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, account_naver_access AS accountNaverAccess, account_naver_secret AS accountNaverSecret, account_naver_customer AS accountNaverCustomer FROM h3_account WHERE account_naver_access IS NOT NULL AND account_naver_customer IS NOT NULL AND account_naver_secret IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h3_naver_delta (deltakey, delta, message, name, success, daily_update, jobid, userid) VALUES (#{deltakey}, #{delta}, '', #{name}, 1, #{delta}, #{jobid}, #{userid})
